title: Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood
event_location: Queen's Park Café, Queen's Park Road, Heywood
description:
Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.

The dates are Saturday 12, Sunday 13, Saturday 19, Sunday 20, Monday 21 and Wednesday 23 December.

Children's tickets cost £16 and include a children's breakfast and a drink, Christmas craft and colouring, a Christmas present for each child, and a meet and greet with Santa. Adult tickets cost £10 for a traditional English breakfast with instant coffee or tea.

Bookings can be made by messaging the café on Facebook, calling in at the café, or messaging 07983 737871. Spaces are only secured once paid in full and booked in advance, and the café asks families to mention any allergies when booking.

title: Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood
event_location: Ian's Gate, rear of 193 Manchester Road, Heywood OL10 2PP
description:
Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road.

The family-friendly event features traditional Christmas carols, a chance for children to meet Santa, and complimentary snacks and drinks.

Entry is free, but the church advises booking in advance. Bookings should be made by Thursday 3 December, when places will be allocated. Bookings can be made through the church's online booking form.

title: Kids' Mini Santa Dash and Christmas movie afternoon at Denehurst House Café
event_location: Denehurst House Café, Denehurst Park, Edenfield Road, Rochdale
description:
Get Together After Serving (GTAS), the veterans' community interest company that runs Denehurst House Café, is holding a Kids' Mini Santa Dash and Christmas movie afternoon on Monday 21 December, from 12pm to 3pm.

The film starts at 12.15pm, and the children's mini Santa Dash takes place during the interval.

Tickets cost £5 per child, which includes a Fruit Shoot and a packet of crisps.

title: KYP Community Cinema: Home Alone
event_location: Kashmir Youth Project (KYP), Belfield Road, Rochdale OL16 2UP
description:
KYP's Community Cinema is showing the family Christmas comedy Home Alone on Thursday 17 December. Doors open at 5.30pm and the film starts at 6.30pm.

Entry costs £3. All ages are welcome and there is free parking. Tickets can be booked through Eventbrite.

The screening is part of the Community Cinema KYP launched in July in partnership with Film Hub North.
